notes.title: 1.63d Update
notes.content: [p]Hi Commanders,   Thanks for all the feedback it's great to see all the HarpGamers streaming in to support this classic.   [/p][p][/p][p]We noticed your posts on the lack of a 1.63d update. The team have now updated the game to that version.   [/p][p][/p][p][i]Tip: Lost a window because you dragged it all the way down? Click on the Windows tab and then click on tile or cascade option to get them all back in your view. [/i]      [/p]
